The '''Ephor's Palace of Septimont''', or simply the '''Ephor's Palace''', is the ruling government faction of the city-state of [[Septimont]].

It is composed of a Senate of counselors and politicians overseen and guided by an Ephor, whose position is attained through a form of combat merit gained from prevailing over the [[Great Agon]] that occurs once every four years.
